name: Proof of Process (PoP) EAT Profile
description: IETF RATS Entity Attestation Token (EAT) profile for CPoE proof-of-process authorship attestation results, named by CWT/EAT claim key 265 (eat_profile).
basedOn: draft-condrey-rats-pop (individual submission, expired 2026-08-15, not yet WG-adopted)
notes: Published by the LF Decentralized Trust proof-of-effort project so the profile has a vendor-neutral home. urn:ietf:params: is IANA-controlled and this profile was never IETF-WG-adopted, so the URN form is not used.
